description: The shop outgrew itself and spilled onto the grass: a wardrobe, four dining chairs and a rolled carpet stand out front under a tarpaulin covering about half of what it needs to. A board leans against the wardrobe reading VELK'S, PRE-OWNED, and beneath that, EVERYTHING IN HERE OUTLIVED SOMEBODY. Past the door the stacking starts in earnest. The door is east; Ironside Street runs west through the pasture.
name: Velk's Pre-Owned Furnishings
